caption: The drawing features a single blue flower with eight rounded petals and a round center. The flower is attached to a curved stem that extends diagonally from the bottom left to the center of the frame. Two elongated blue leaves with pointed tips branch off from the lower part of the stem, one on each side. The flower and leaves are outlined in white or a light shade, making them stand out from the background. The background consists of an even, textured brownish-grey color, which fills the rectangular inner section of the artwork. The overall drawing is bordered by a wide, plain off-white margin surrounding the inner rectangle.
title: Jar
